3532-5078-5402-8346.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-5078-5402-8346.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Captain Storm.
Repeat.

4693-4875-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
4693-4875-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Overgrown Estate ability, causing you to gain 3 life.
Repeat from step 3.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-1116-3249-4289--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-1116-3249-4289--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Cryptolith Rite by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Sek'Kuar triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

1315-3234-3293-6495.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
1315-3234-3293-6495.description:
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat
1315-3234-3293-6495.notes:
You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.
If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

2738-4871-5147-7316.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Rat King, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Rat King trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2728-6798-6854-7957.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Rikku does not have summoning sickness.
2728-6798-6854-7957.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
2728-6798-6854-7957.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Rikku's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Host of the Hereafter and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Host of the Hereafter trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat from step 4.

3532-5078-6259-7750.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-5078-6259-7750.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Medusa triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

719-4302-6797.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
719-4302-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Xenograft, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

2511-5571-7666--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

3372-5231-5434-6006.manaNeeded: {1}{W} if Enduring Vitality is not a creature
3372-5231-5434-6006.description:
If Enduring Vitality is not a creature, activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Enduring Vitality to become a creature.
Activate Enduring Vitality by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Enduring Vitality, adding {R}.
When Enduring Vitality dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as an enchantment.
Repeat.

3430-4499-6664-6973.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Mutable Explorer.
When Mutable Explorer enters, it triggers, creating an untapped Mutavault land token due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Activate the Mutavault token by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Repeat.

813-3378-3821.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}.
813-3378-3821.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}.
Cast Illusionist's Stratagem by paying {3}{U}, blinking Scholar of the Ages and Peregrine Drake and causing you to draw a card.
When Scholar of the Ages and Peregrine Drake enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Scholar of the Ages trigger, returning Illusionist's Stratagem to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Repeat.
813-3378-3821.notes: If you control five lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Peregrine Drake.

2292-3490-4455-7426.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
2292-3490-4455-7426.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Ghost Lantern triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta and Animation Module trigger.
Resolve the Berta trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat

851-1722-2034-2713-7365.description:
Activate Katara by paying at most {4} due to Zirda, causing you to draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create two creature tokens.
Activate Katara by paying at most {2} and tapping the creature tokens.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Katara ability, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
851-1722-2034-2713-7365.notes: The mana cost can be reduced if you tap combo pieces or other applicable permanents while activating Katara's waterbend ability the first iteration. As the combo will net {C} each iteration, you can forego sacrificing and/or tapping both tokens on some loops.

1453-2387-3480-3490.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
1453-2387-3480-3490.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token that enters with a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to Arwen's toughness.
Animation Module triggers. Holding priority, activate the Servo by tapping it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token that enters with a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to Arwen's toughness.
Repeat from step 3.

1086-3490-5231-6283.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
You have a nonland card on top of your library.
1086-3490-5231-6283.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Anointer Priest and Thermopod indestructible.
1086-3490-5231-6283.description:
Gain life.
Amalia triggers, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Anointer Priest triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Amalia triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Amalia trigger, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Repeat from step 3.

requires.n: Permanent tapping to deal damage to any target

4831-5358--96.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Cacophodon indestructible.
4831-5358--96.description:
Give Cacophodon indestructible, if needed.
Activate the permanent that can deal damage by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to Cacophodon, triggering Cacophodon twice.
Resolve the first Cacophodon trigger, untapping the permanent that deals damage.
Holding priority, activate the permanent by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the second Cacophodon trigger, untapping the permanent.
Repeat from step 2.
4831-5358--96.notes: You can skip steps 4 and 5, if desired, to untap another permanent instead.

2060-4013-4186-4929-6457.easyPrerequisites: You control an additional nonland permanent.
2060-4013-4186-4929-6457.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Felothar.
When Felothar enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice a nonland permanent and put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {1}.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.

1812-2440-4183-4730.notablePrerequisites:
Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
{U}{R} available, plus an additional {U}{R} if you control less than three creatures that share a creature type with Sparring Mummy
1812-2440-4183-4730.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Sparring Mummy with haste.
When the token Sparring Mummy enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Sparring Mummy trigger, untapping Saheeli.
Holding priority, if you control less than four creatures that share a creature type with Sparring Mummy, repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time.
Resolve all Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with Sparring Mummy for each trigger resolved this way.
Activate Prismite twice by paying {4}, adding {U}{R}.
Repeat.

413-2533-2719-4681.description:
Activate Loyal Retainers by sacrificing it, returning Sakashima from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Karmic Guide.
When Sakashima enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Sakashima trigger, returning Loyal Retainers from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Sakashima.
Repeat.

413-586-2146-5258-5618.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Repeat.

1741-2232-5778.notablePrerequisites: You control up to two lands that can tap to produce at least {1}{U}.
1741-2232-5778.description:
Activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Cast Cloud of Faeries by paying {1}{U} plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
When Cloud of Faeries enters the battlefield, it triggers twice and Cloudstone Curio triggers once.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand.
Resolve the first Cloud of Faeries trigger, untapping up to two lands.
Holding priority, activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Resolve the second Cloud of Faeries trigger, creating a token copy of it that is 1/1.
When the Cloud of Faeries token enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the nontoken Cloud of Faeries from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Cloud of Faeries token's trigger, untapping up to two lands.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

204-392-1858-2056-4885.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one white permanent.
204-392-1858-2056-4885.description:
Cast View from Above by paying {1}{U}.
Birgi and Saheeli trigger.
Resolve the Birgi trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve the Saheeli trigger, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve View from Above, returning it to your hand.
Activate the Servo by tapping it, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast an instant or sorcery spell, or to gain a Class level.
Repeat.

248-2292-2721.description:
Cast Changeling Berserker by paying {3}{R}.
Changeling Berserker enters the battlefield, championing Bloodline Necromancer.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Changeling Berserker.
Changeling Berserker dies, causing Bloodline Necromancer to return to the battlefield from exile.
Bloodline Necromancer enters the battlefield, returning Changeling Berserker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
Resolve all Viscera Seer abilities, causing you to scry 1 an infinite number of times.

624-628-4053.description:
Cast Phantasmal Image by paying {1}{U}, having it enter as a copy of Mikaeus.
Choose to have Phantasmal Image put into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Phantasmal Image dies, triggering its undying ability, returning itself to the battlefield with no +1/+1 counters due to Solemnity, as a copy of Mikaeus.
Repeat from step 2.

291-1283-2034-4853.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Activate Myr Matrix by paying {5}, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Myr, adding {2}.
The Myr dies, triggering Dross Scorpion, untapping Chromatic Orrery.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, if you control a colored permanent, you may activate Chromatic Orrery's second ability instead to draw infinite cards.

147-3269-4050.description:
Cast Ascend from Avernus by paying {3}{W}{W}{W}.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, creating a copy of Ascend from Avernus.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, adding one mana of any color.
Resolve the copy of Ascend from Avernus, returning all creature and planeswalker cards with mana value three or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
